cases.title: Half marathon under 1:30, never run, one day a week (mine)

input.goal: Finish a half marathon in under 1 hour 30 minutes
input.baseline: I have never run. I can't jog for more than a minute.

coachNote.message: One day a week cannot safely build from never running to an under-1:30 half marathon. That target is a major longer-term challenge; a first honest plan would need at least 4 days a week.
